title: Track your shipment
subtitle: Enter your tracking number to see the status of your delivery.
notFoundHint: No shipment matches number {{code}}. Please check the code and try again.
errorHint: Tracking cannot be retrieved right now. Please try again shortly.
privacyNote: For your security, only delivery information is shown. Personal data stays protected.
